notes: 100% CPT is a separately shown qualitative control; its exact time/temperature and precursor charges are not stated in Figure S1.
Step I MeOAc volume differs between SI Methods (3 mL) and SI Figure S3 caption (2 mL); assignment to a particular aliquot is unresolved.
Main p.2 reports that full CPT replacement yields NCs but worsens colloidal stability; SI S1d shows purified product.

This remains a source-observed qualitative control, not a complete recipe. Figure S3a directly links it to Step I and Step II purification, but the Step I caption's 2 mL MeOAc conflicts with the general Methods 3 mL, and Step II quantitative conditions are not sample-specific.
This qualitative control is not an eligible recipe–structure pair or training-ready recipe; SI Figure S1 does not provide the essential quantitative synthesis parameters.

quality.review_scope: Selected main pp.1-3 and SI pp.1-3,5-7 qualitative 100% CPT control. Prior scoped quick audit and accepted targeted r1/r2 deltas cover Figure S3a Step I/II workup and Figure S1b-c CPT sulfur-source/pre-injection seed state; this is not a full-paper re-audit. Explicit recipe-pair eligibility remains withheld because precursor charges, synthesis temperature and reaction duration are not source-linked.
missing_fields: No quantitative diameter is given for the 100% CPT product; SI Figure S1d supports qualitative TEM only.
No sample-specific XRD curve for this ratio in SI Figure S4; main text phase statement is study-wide.
Exact DPhTA injection DMF volume is unreported for CPT branch; do not copy the 0% branch 1 mL quantity.
Figure S1 gives no AgI, BiI3, CPT or DPhTA mmol for this 100% control.
Temperature, reaction hold, Step II purification quantities and final dispersion solvent are not individually reported for the 100% CPT control; Figure S3a supplies only Step I's disputed 2 mL claim.
SI Figure S1b identifies small pre-injection AgBiS2 seeds but gives no seed diameter, yield or formation kinetics for this 100% CPT control.
conflicts: SI p.2 Methods reports 3 mL methyl acetate in purification Step I; SI p.6 Figure S3 caption reports 2 mL for Step I. Retain both without choosing.
